name: diff-review
description: Review pane for uncommitted changes, the pull request or one commit at a time: ask Claude about any line, read and settle GitHub review threads, all from the keyboard

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Colors of the review pane: auto follows the Claude Code theme.

key_uncommitted_view.title: Key: Uncommitted changes
key_uncommitted_view.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: 1.

key_pr_view.title: Key: Pull request
key_pr_view.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: 2.

key_commits_view.title: Key: Commits
key_commits_view.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: 3.

key_previous_view.title: Key: Previous view
key_previous_view.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: q on AZERTY, a on QWERTY.

key_next_view.title: Key: Next view
key_next_view.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: d.

key_previous_file.title: Key: Previous file
key_previous_file.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: z on AZERTY, w on QWERTY.

key_next_file.title: Key: Next file
key_next_file.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: s.

key_mark_viewed.title: Key: Mark viewed on GitHub, go to the next unviewed
key_mark_viewed.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: y.

key_filter_files.title: Key: Filter the files (Enter goes back to the diff)
key_filter_files.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: i.

key_previous_line.title: Key: Line above
key_previous_line.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: k.

key_next_line.title: Key: Line below
key_next_line.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: j.

key_previous_hunk.title: Key: Previous hunk (@@ block)
key_previous_hunk.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: b.

key_next_hunk.title: Key: Next hunk (@@ block)
key_next_hunk.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: f.

key_more_context.title: Key: More context around the changes
key_more_context.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: u.

key_whole_file.title: Key: The whole file, changes in place
key_whole_file.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: l.

key_split_view.title: Key: Side by side or unified (wide diff)
key_split_view.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: t.

key_ask_on_line.title: Key: Ask Claude about the line (Enter too)
key_ask_on_line.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: c.

key_reply_on_line.title: Key: Reply in the thread of the line
key_reply_on_line.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: r.

key_previous_thread.title: Key: Previous thread
key_previous_thread.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: p.

key_next_thread.title: Key: Next thread
key_next_thread.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: n.

key_resolve_thread.title: Key: Resolve or unresolve the GitHub thread
key_resolve_thread.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: x.

key_open_on_github.title: Key: Open the comment, commit or PR on GitHub
key_open_on_github.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: o.

key_mark_file.title: Key: Mark the new file
key_mark_file.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: v.

key_mark_all_new.title: Key: Mark every new file
key_mark_all_new.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: m.

key_stage_marked.title: Key: git add the marked files
key_stage_marked.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: g.

key_stage_all.title: Key: git add everything
key_stage_all.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: e.

key_help.title: Key: This help
key_help.description: One letter or digit (several: comma separated). Empty keeps the default: h.
